subject: Paper on zero-inflated modeling using Nimble

messages.author: 63cc02caac0434cf
messages.subject: Paper on zero-inflated modeling using Nimble
parts:
Hi Everyone,

My supervisor and I wrote a paper about zero-inflated modeling through Markov switching (hidden Markov) models. It is aimed at spatio-temporal infectious disease counts but could be used for other data types. I thought people here might be interested because we use Nimble and we include all code and data. There are some examples of complex custom samplers.

The paper is here https://rss.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/rssc.12547 and here is a read-only sharable link for those without a subscription to the journal  https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/share/author/HHPPTJNNXBACKRBARHAD?target=10.1111/rssc.12547 .  The GitHub link with the code and data is here https://github.com/Dirk-Douwes-Schultz/ZS_CMSP_code . 

I would recommend reading the pdf version. 

If you have questions or comments please email me, dirk.douw...@mail.mcgill.ca

Thanks!
Dirk Douwes-Schultz
